div.head: Quadr Arg 27
div.ab: Qui non solum lagam regis Eadwardi nobis reddidit, quam omni gaudiorum delectatione suscepimus, sed, beati patris eius emendationibus roboratam, propriis institutionibus honestauit in omnibus quæ Dei sunt et uitæ uel uirtutis.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 535 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: vgl. o. 16; u. 28; II Praef. 12; CHn cor. 13; Wl art. 7
cf. above 16; below 28; II Praef. 12; CHn cor. 13; Wl art. 7
ausser CHn cor. meint Verf. wohl Hn com., o. S. 524, u. II 19, S. 546
besides CHn cor. the author probably means Hn com., above p. 524, below II 19, p. 546
Hier fühlt Verfasser sich als Engländer, so dass die Laga Eadwardi (s. d. Gl. 2; Wilhelm I. 7e) auch ihm zurückgegeben scheint, während er o. 11{k} sie als nur von Angligenis ersehnt hinstellte

Here the author feels himself an Englishman, so that the Laga Eadwardi (see that word in Gl. 2; Wilhelm I. 7e) seems to have been given back to him too, whereas above 11{k} he represented it as longed for only by the Angligenis
